transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hello. Well, what brings me in is that I keep arranging my entire life—especially my own house—around not seeing spiders. 

It's gotten to the point where I put off doing the laundry just because the machines are down in the basement. I completely avoid the garden shed, too. I've even started paying people to do small maintenance jobs around the house that I know perfectly well how to do myself, simply because I can’t make myself go into those spaces. I just... I need to get a handle on it, because it's getting ridiculous.
Do you feel driven to perform any repetitive rituals or checking routines to make sure spiders aren't around?

No, I don't really do anything like that. I don't have any rituals or routines for checking. It's really just... I just avoid the places where I think they might be altogether. If I don't go down to the basement, I don't have to worry about looking for them. So, no, no repetitive checking.
How long have you been dealing with this fear and avoidance of spiders?
It's been going on for about thirteen months now. It really started shortly after I moved into the house... I found those spiders while I was unpacking, and ever since then, it's just been a problem.
